digest_table.description: One table of the Digest of Education Statistics as its Excel file: enrollment, teachers, finances, degrees, outcomes, from pre-K to postsecondary. Default: every line numbered (row, col1...) to find the header lines; then header_lines (usually '3-4') names the columns.

edition.desc: two-digit Digest edition, e.g. 25 (Digest 2025); not every table is in every edition

table.desc: table number, e.g. 203.10 (public school enrollment by grade)

header_row.desc: one header line instead; 0 (default) returns every line numbered

carry.desc: which header lines span to the right over blank cells: top (default), all, none; check the names against the numbered lines

ipeds.description: An IPEDS complete data file (one row per institution, or institution by category), e.g. HD2023 directory, EFFY2023 12-month enrollment, C2023_A completions by CIP code, ADM2023 admissions, SFA2223 student aid, F2223_F2 finance. The revised (_rv) version is read when the zip has one.

file.desc: IPEDS file name as on the Data Center's Complete Data Files page, e.g. HD2023, EFFY2023, C2023_A

unitid.desc: keep only these institutions (UNITID, a list works)

state.desc: keep only these states (two-letter STABBR; files that have that column, e.g. HD)

member.desc: the CSV in the zip, e.g. c2023_a.csv for the original instead of the revised file

ipeds_dictionary.description: The data dictionary of an IPEDS file: variable names and titles (sheet Varlist), code values and labels (Frequencies), long descriptions (Description).

file.desc: the IPEDS file name, e.g. HD2023
